name: SLVEST
recent: Solarvest 近期委任两名高层主管（包括首席能源转型官），以推动综合清洁能源业务扩张；同时雇员认股计划（ESOS）持续行使，新股分批上市。大股东 Prudential PLC 的持股变动公告频繁，Urusharta Jamaah 则于10月8日公告不再是大股东。
notable: 委任 Lee Chung Min James 为首席能源转型官，自2026年11月3日生效。
委任 Wong Aik Peoy 为高层主管（Principal Officer），自2026年11月3日生效。
Prudential PLC 于10月23日发出权益通知，成为大股东，随后多次申报持股变动。
risks: Urusharta Jamaah Sdn. Bhd. 于10月8日公告不再是大股东。
董事 Lim Chin Siu 和 Tan Chyi Boon 于10月6日各减持300万股；同日 Dato' Chong Chun Shiong 增持600万股。
首席运营官 Yap Pei Koon 于10月9日行使ESOS取得18万股。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为1.559亿令吉，环比下降42.0%，但同比增长13.2%；净利为1,902万令吉，环比下降21.3%，同比增长19.8%；净利率为12.2%，高于上一季度的9.0%。

recent_en: Solarvest recently appointed two senior executives, including a Chief Energy Transition Officer, to drive expansion into integrated clean energy solutions. Meanwhile, new shares continued to be listed from the exercise of ESOS. Prudential PLC filed frequent changes in substantial shareholder interest, while Urusharta Jamaah announced cessation as a substantial shareholder on 8 October.
notable_en: Appointed Lee Chung Min James as Chief Energy Transition Officer, effective 3 November 2026.
Appointed Wong Aik Peoy as Principal Officer, effective 3 November 2026.
Prudential PLC filed a notice of interest to become a substantial shareholder on 23 October, followed by multiple filings of changes in its interest.
risks_en: Urusharta Jamaah Sdn. Bhd. announced cessation as a substantial shareholder on 8 October.
Directors Lim Chin Siu and Tan Chyi Boon each disposed of 3 million shares on 6 October; Dato' Chong Chun Shiong acquired 6 million shares on the same day.
Chief Operating Officer Yap Pei Koon exercised ESOS for 180,000 shares and disposed of 55,000 shares on 9 October.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR155.9 million, down 42.0% QoQ but up 13.2% YoY; net income was MYR19.0 million, down 21.3% QoQ but up 19.8% YoY; net margin was 12.2%, higher than 9.0% in the previous quarter.
